ModMetaData.name: RimAI.Art
ModMetaData.author: changlusss
ModMetaData.description:
RimAI.Art — artistic artifact generation for RimWorld. Literature is the current built-in implementation.
Key Features: • Automatically repairs and normalizes book titles and descriptions • Generates short, localized book synopses instead of placeholder text • Books written by pawns reflect their personal experiences and memories • Reading and storytelling dialogue is based on actual book content • Optional compatibility with Vanilla Books Expanded and Children’s Books • Art-object title/description generation for CompArt items
Gameplay text AI uses the shared RimAI configuration. Literature-specific prompts and rewrite lists stay in this module.
